11300.meaning1: teacher and teacher's teachers; current and former teachers; lineage of teachers

examples.text: mayā'pi kho etaṃ, bho gotama, sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, ārogyaparamā lābhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhan'ti. ta'y'idaṃ, bho gotama, sametī'ti.
ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā.

11302.meaning2: (one) having the status of a teacher; like a teacher

11303.meaning2: line of teachers; ancestor of the teachers

11304.meaning1: generation of teachers; lineage of teachers

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ek'ācariyo'pi, ek'ācariyapācariyo'pi, yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugā'pi, yo evam'āha, aham'etaṃ jānāmi, aham'etaṃ passāmi. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?

11306.meaning2: teacher's hidden knowledge; lit. teacher's fist
11306.commentary: (SNa) ācariyamuṭṭhī'ti yathā bāhirakānaṃ ācariyamuṭṭhi nāma hoti, daharakāle kassaci akathetvā pacchimakāle maraṇamañ'ce nipannā piyamanāpassa antevāsikassa kathenti, evaṃ tathāgatassa idaṃ mahallakakāle pacchimaṭhāne kathessāmī'ti muṭṭhiṃ katvā pariharitvā ṭhapitaṃ kiñci n'atthī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: desito, ānanda, mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ karitvā. n'atth'ānanda, tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhi.

11307.commentary: (VINa) ācariyaleso nāma itthan'nāmassa antevāsiko diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ itthan'nāmassa antevāsikaṃ passitvā codeti, itthan'nāmassa antevāsiko mayā diṭṭho.

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.

11308.meaning1: like the teacher; equal to one's teacher (in)

examples.text: tevijjānaṃ yadakkhātaṃ, tatra kevalino'smase, padakasmā veyyākaraṇā, jappe ācariyasādisā, tesaṃ no jātivādasmiṃ, vivādo atthi gotama.

11310.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

11311.meaning2: woman teacher, wife of a teacher

examples.text: kiṃ pana, vāseṭṭha, atthi koci tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ yāva sattamā ācariyāmahayugā yena brahmā sakkhidiṭṭho'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

seyyathā'pi nāma anākappasampanne bhikkhū disvā ācariy'upajjhāye garahanti kass'ime saddhivihārikā, kass'antevāsikā'ti, seyyathā vā pana kulakumārake vā kulakumārikāyo vā dussīle pāpadhamme disvā mātāpitaro garahanti kass'ime puttā, kassa dhītaro'ti

11314.meaning1: risk for the teacher; danger to the teacher
11314.commentary: (MNa) ācariy'ūpaddavenā'ti abbhantare uppannena kiles'ūpaddavena ācariyass'upaddavo. ses'upaddavesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tatr'ānanda, yo c'ev'āyaṃ ācariy'ūpaddavo, yo ca antevās'ūpaddavo ayaṃ tehi brahmac'ārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro c'eva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.

11315.commentary: (MNa) ācāmo'ti bhattaukkhalikāya laggo jhāmaodano, taṃ chaḍḍitaṭṭhāne gahetvā khādati. odanakañjiyan'ti'pi vadanti.

examples.text: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

11317.meaning1: feeding on rice water; eating pot scum
11317.commentary: (MNa) ācāmo'ti bhattaukkhalikāya laggo jhāmaodano, taṃ chaḍḍitaṭṭhāne gahetvā khādati. odanakañjiyan'ti'pi vadanti.

examples.text: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

11318.meaning1: rinses; washes; (comm) gives water for rinsing
11318.commentary: (MNa) ācamehī'ti ācaman'odakaṃ dehi. ācamitvā hatthapāde dhovitvā mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā satthāraṃ namassitu'kāmo evam'āha. (MNt) ācamehī'ti ācamanaṃ mukhavikkhālanaṃ kārehi. yasmā mukhaṃ vikkhālentā hi hatthapāde dhovitvā vikkhālenti, tasmā ācamitvā'ti vatvā pacchā'pi tassa atthaṃ dassento mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā'ti āha.

examples.text: ehi, mallike, ācāmehī'ti.

mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.

11320.meaning1: custom; norm; social convention; polite behaviour

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā naehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti
tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, pacchābhattaṃ bhuttapātarāsassa ayam'ācāro hoti, ārāmena ārāmaṃ uyyānena uyyānaṃ anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi.

11322.commentary: (SNa) tattha yo yato kutoci kulā pabbajitvā sīl'ādayo pañca dhammakkhandhe pūreti, ayaṃ ācārakulaputto nāma.

11323.commentary: (DHPa) ācārakusalo'ti sīlam'pi ācāro, vattapaṭivattam'pi ācāro. tattha kusalo siyā, cheko bhaveyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.

11324.meaning2: conduct and suitable places; lit. behaviour and pasture

examples.text: etha tumhe, āvuso, sīlavā hotha, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesū'ti

11325.meaning1: who knows how to behave and keep to suitable places; well behaved and restrained

11327.meaning1: teaching the prescribed rules of conduct

11329.commentary: (VSa) tattha garukānaṃ dvinnaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ vasena sīlavipatticodanā veditabbā, avasesānaṃ vasena ācāravipatticodanā, micchādiṭṭhi-antaggāhika-diṭṭhivasena diṭṭhivipatticodanā, ājīvahetu paññattānaṃ channaṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ vasena ājīvavipatticodanā veditabbā.

examples.text: ācāravipattiyā vā diṭṭhivipattiyā vā anuddhaṃseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anupasampannaṃ anuddhaṃseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
andhatamaṃ tadā hoti andhakāratimisā. n'eva tāva catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ ācikkhaṇā hoti desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ.

atthi, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo, taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti, abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā taṃ ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.

11334.synonym: akkhāna, ākkhāna, ākhyāna, ācikkhanā, ārocana, pavedana, byākaraṇa

examples.text: utu'kkhānaṃ, hem'ant'ādīnaṃ tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ, ettakaṃ atikkantaṃ, ettakaṃ avasiṭṭhan'ti. evaṃ utu-ācikkhanaṃ kataṃ kiṃ?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: evaṃ utu-ācikkhanaṃ. utūn'īdha pana sāsane hem'anta-gimha-vassānānaṃ vasena tīṇi honti.

11335.commentary: (SNa) diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhan'ti diṭṭhaṃ, diṭṭhaṃ me'ti sutaṃ, sutaṃ me'ti ācikkhanto, na niguhanto.

examples.text: jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

11336.meaning1: having made show; having made tell

examples.text: satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi
idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.
tadabhiññā ācikkhiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ. ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti.
amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti. sace passitvā na ācikkhati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. sace ācikkhite paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
ta'y'idaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatan'ti.

11340.meaning1: should be told; should be informed

examples.text: dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti.
rūpena vā nimittena vā saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, yassa bhaṇḍaṃ naṭṭhaṃ so āgacchatū'ti.

11342.meaning1: to explain; to describe; to point out; to demonstrate

examples.text: sakkā evam'evaṃ viññāṇam'p'idaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ iti'p'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā'ti.
ahaṃ kho, āvuso, navo acirapabbajito adhun'āgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ. na t'āhaṃ sakkomi vitthārena ācikkhituṃ.

11343.meaning1: having told; having related; having described

examples.text: amhākañ'ca iminā ca iminā ca bhesajjena attho'ti ācikkhitvā viññāpeti, yāsu tayā rattīsu pavāritāmha tāyo ca rattiyo vītivattā amhākañ'ca bhesajjena attho'ti ācikkhitvā viññāpeti
nārado sabbaṃ taṃ pavattiṃ ācikkhitvā iminā kāraṇena ahaṃ iminā abhisapito, ath'āhaṃ, mayhaṃ doso n'atthi, yassa doso atthi, tass'eva upari abhisapo patatū'ti vatvā abhisapiṃ

11345.meaning1: being informed; being told; being spoken to (by)

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!
na kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa kammaṃ, kamman'ti paññapetuṃ. daṇḍaṃ, daṇḍan'ti kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa paññapetun'ti.

11347.commentary: (ANa) sutt'antapariyāyena devasikaṃ phalasamāpatti-samāpajjanaṃ mahākaruṇāsamāpatti-samāpajjanaṃ buddhacakkhunā lokavolokanaṃ aṭṭh'uppattivasena sutt'antadesanā jātakakathā'ti idaṃ āciṇṇaṃ, na devasikaṃ phalasamāpatti-samāpajjanaṃ… na jātakakathā'ti idaṃ anāciṇṇaṃ. vinayapariyāyena nimantitassa vass'āvāsaṃ vasitvā apaloketvā cārikāpakkamanaṃ pavāretvā cārikāpakkamanaṃ, āgantukehi saddhiṃ paṭhamaṃ paṭisanthārakaraṇan'ti idaṃ āciṇṇaṃ, tass'eva āciṇṇassa akaraṇaṃ anāciṇṇaṃ nāma.

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū … anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā'ti dīpenti … āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā'ti dīpenti … te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujana-ahitāya paṭipannā bahujana-asukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

11348.meaning1: practice of (performing) what was done (by one's teacher and preceptor)
11348.commentary: (VINt) kappati āciṇṇakappo'ti ācariy'upajjhāyehi āciṇṇo kappatī'ti attho. so pana ekacco kappati dhammiko, ekacco na kappati adhammiko'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo, kappati dv'aṅgulakappo, kappati gām'antarakappo, kappati āvāsakappo, kappati anumatikappo, kappati āciṇṇakappo, kappati amathitakappo, kappati jaḷogiṃ pātuṃ, kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ, kappati jātarūparajatan'ti.
ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāva'd'atthaṃ pāripūriṃ. tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño mās'ācitaṃ maññe. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.
m'āvamaññetha pāpassa, na man'taṃ āgamissati, udabindunipātena, udakumbho'pi pūrati, bālo pūrati pāpassa, thokaṃ thokam'pi ācinaṃ.
tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā rūpasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti no ācināti, pajahati no upādiyati, visineti no ussineti, vidhūpeti no sandhūpeti

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo.
dullabho purisa-ājañño, na so sabbattha jāyati, yattha so jāyati dhīro, taṃ kulaṃ sukham'edhati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo.
gedhaṃ brūmi mah'ogho'ti, ājavaṃ brūmi jappanaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ pakappanaṃ, kāmapaṅko duraccayo.
passa dhammaṃ durājānaṃ, sampamūḷh'etth'aviddasu, nivutānaṃ tamo hoti, andhakāro apassataṃ.

acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma'd'eva satthusāsanaṃ ājānantena, evam'eva āyasmatā puṇṇena mantāṇiputtena gambhīrā gambhīrapañhā anumassa anumassa byākatā.

aho, vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyun'ti. iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, kāruññaṃ paṭicca anuddayaṃ paṭicca anukampaṃ upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
kiṃ pattinam'āhu vedaguṃ, anuviditaṃ kena kathañ'ca vīriyavā'ti, ājāniyo kin'ti nāma hoti, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
yass'assu lunāni bandhanāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca saṅgamūlaṃ, sabbasaṅgamūlabandhanā pamutto, ājāniyo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
